tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Improved compactness of three-dimensional $\kappa $-solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0158, page-0159 ↗ cor:chow-iii-3d-kappa-compactness ↗ thm:chow-iii-kappa-gap 1. ch20:20.11\group Compactness

The union, over all $\kappa >0$, of the noncompact three-dimensional $\kappa $-solutions is compact modulo scaling. The corresponding union of nonspherical-space-form three-dimensional $\kappa $-solutions is precompact modulo scaling, although a limit may be spherical.
Proof

\sketch The three-dimensional gap theorem supplies one uniform $\kappa _0>0$ for all members of either union. Apply Corollary 3. Noncompactness is preserved in the first family; in the second family only precompactness is asserted because a spherical limit is possible.

□
